items.title: Bob Watts Interview, 1963-02-28
items.q: INTERVIEWEE: Not that, what is he? Charlie Weaver, the comedian? ... No, I've never seen him play nothing.

ctx.x: Pete was as happy as he could be. Yeah, they walked one week. And Charlie Weaver played Cornette with him, you know, the comedian. You didn't know, I didn't know that. He's on the Today Show or something. Is he? Yeah.
Not that, what is he? Charlie Weaver, the comedian?
